title: Jensen Huang Built Nvidia in a Denny's Booth. Then He Resigned.
description:
Jensen Huang went from washing dishes at Denny's to planning Nvidia in a Denny's booth.

The quick version:
- At 15, Huang worked at a Denny's in Portland, Oregon: dishwasher, busboy, waiter.
- In 1993 he met engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in a booth at a Denny's in San Jose, California, to plan a graphics chip company. His reason: all the coffee you could drink and nobody could chase you out.
- That company became Nvidia, now the AI chip giant worth trillions. In 2023 Denny's put a plaque on the booth: "The booth that launched a $1 trillion company."
- On Nov. 12, 2026, Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and left its board, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO.
- After he resigned, the plaque was taken down. Days later Denny's reinstalled it.

questions.q: Was Nvidia really founded at Denny's?
questions.a: Yes. In 1993 Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem met in a booth at a Denny's in San Jose, California, to plan the company. In 2023 Denny's put a plaque on that booth.

questions.q: Did Jensen Huang work at Denny's?
questions.a: Yes. His first job, at 15, was at a Denny's in Portland, Oregon, where he worked as a dishwasher, busboy and waiter, according to Nvidia.

questions.q: What happened to the Nvidia plaque at Denny's?
questions.a: After Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO on November 12, 2026, the plaque on the San Jose booth was taken down. A few days later Denny's said it had reinstalled it.
